result.summary: Found 1 significant data-display defect: an invalid delivery price renders as “€NaN”. Excluded edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff per instructions.

issues.description: The “Smash Bros Burgers” card shows “€NaN delivery”, indicating a missing/invalid delivery fee value is being rendered to users.
issues.suggestion: Handle null/undefined delivery fees before rendering; show a valid formatted price, “Free delivery”, or hide the delivery fee label instead of NaN.
